subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The doctor ______ two tablets per day.
solution:
The correct answer is **"prescribed".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Prescribed"** means to officially recommend or authorize the use of a medicine or treatment. (किसी के लिए दवा या इलाज तय करना; नुसख़ा लिखना)

 
 
• **Example:** *Can you **prescribe**__ something for my cough please, doctor?*
 
 
 
• In this context, the doctor is recommending the patient take two tablets per day.
 
• The word **"prescribed"** is the most appropriate option because it accurately reflects the professional nature of a doctor's recommendation.
 
• So, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 

**Correct sentence:** *The doctor __**prescribed**__ two tablets per day.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **"Advised"** means to give counsel or guidance on a decision or course of action. (सलाह या सुझाव देना)

 
 
• **Example: ***The financial advisor **advised**__ her to invest in stocks*.
 
 
 
• **"Ordered" **means to give an authoritative command or instruction. (आदेश, आज्ञा या हुक्‍म देना)
 __
 
• **Example:** *The general **ordered**__ his troops to advance.*)
 
 
 
• **"Proposed"** means to put forward a plan or suggestion for consideration. (किसी योजना या कार्यक्रम को विचारार्थ प्रस्‍तुत करना)
 __
 
• **Example: ***The committee **proposed**__ a new policy for employee benefits*.
